tools.name: youtube_transcript
tools.description: Get the transcript (captions) of a YouTube video. Returns the full text plus per-segment timings.

tools.name: youtube_transcript_bulk
tools.description: Retrieve transcripts for 1 to 5 pasted YouTube video URLs sequentially within one deadline. One credit per usable success. Inspect each item's attempted, chargeStatus and errorCode; partial results are retained. Do not retry automatically.

tools.name: youtube_stats
tools.description: Get engagement stats for a single YouTube video (views, likes, comments, publish date, channel info).

tools.name: youtube_comments
tools.description: List comments on a YouTube video. Use limit to bound the returned sample; this endpoint does not accept a pagination cursor.

tools.name: youtube_channel_stats
tools.description: Get channel-level stats (subscribers, total views, video count, profile info) for a YouTube channel URL.

tools.name: youtube_videos
tools.description: List videos from a public YouTube channel or playlist. Available publication dates and descriptions may be missing. Optional full_details enrichment is capped at 30 videos.

tools.name: youtube_search
tools.description: Search YouTube videos by query. Returns the top matching videos.

tools.name: tiktok_stats
tools.description: Get engagement stats for a single TikTok video (views, likes, comments, shares, publish date, author).

tools.name: tiktok_comments
tools.description: List comments on a TikTok video or photo post. Set includeShortShareUrl to add a verified TikTok short link or null per comment; existing shareUrl is retained.

tools.name: tiktok_channel_videos
tools.description: Get a list of recent videos from a TikTok channel. Returns up to 100 videos with metadata (id, description, URL, thumbnail, duration, publish date, views, likes, comments, shares, saves). Supports pagination via the cursor field.

tools.name: instagram_stats
tools.description: Get metadata and a video CDN URL for an Instagram post or reel. Views are optional (null when unavailable); requireViews=true enables strict count recovery. Shares are null when not exposed; unavailable duration is null. Never treat null as zero.

tools.name: instagram_comments
tools.description: List comments on an Instagram post or reel. Check collectionStatus (partial, exhausted, unknown) and stopReason before analysis. hasMore only means a safe cursor is available; false does not prove completeness. Exhausted means available pagination ended, not that hidden comments or replies were coll

tools.name: instagram_channel_stats
tools.description: Get channel-level stats for an Instagram profile (user ID, followers, following, post count, bio, verified).

tools.name: instagram_channel_posts
tools.description: List recent posts from an Instagram profile URL.

tools.name: instagram_channel_reels
tools.description: List recent reels from an Instagram profile URL.

tools.name: facebook_comments
tools.description: List comments on a Facebook post or video.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: youtube_transcript, youtube_transcript_bulk, youtube_stats, youtube_comments, youtube_channel_stats, tiktok_stats, tiktok_comments, tiktok_channel_videos, instagram_stats, instagram_comments, instagram_channel_stats, instagram_channel_posts, instagram_channel_reels, facebook_comments · Public sink: youtube_stats, tiktok_stats, tiktok_comments, tiktok_channel_videos, instagram_stats, instagram_comments, instagram_channel_stats, facebook_comments.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: youtube_transcript, youtube_transcript_bulk, youtube_stats, youtube_comments, youtube_channel_stats, tiktok_stats, tiktok_comments, tiktok_channel_videos, instagram_stats, instagram_comments, instagram_channel_stats, instagram_channel_posts, instagram_channel_reels, facebook_comments · Public sink: youtube_stats, tiktok_stats, tiktok_comments, tiktok_channel_videos, instagram_stats, instagram_comments, instagram_channel_stats, facebook_comments

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
